name: Ring Support Hold
steps: Set gymnastic rings at waist height, grasp them firmly, and press up to support your bodyweight with completely locked elbows.
Depress your shoulder blades strongly away from your ears and brace your abs and glutes with straight legs.
Turn the rings gently outward so your palms face slightly forward while keeping the rings tucked close to your hips.
Hold steadily without shaking or shrugging for the target duration before stepping smoothly back down.
tips: Keep your arms completely locked and press down hard through the rings to stop your shoulders from rising.
Start with neutral palms before turning the rings outward if your stability is still developing.
